title: Procter & Gamble to cut staff at its factories and distribution centers
summary: US consumer goods giant Procter & Gamble (P&G) announced on Thursday, November 19, plans to reduce its manufacturing and logistics workforce by 2030. The cuts could affect up to 30% of the positions concerned, as part of a broader cost-reduction drive. The announcement was made by the management of the consumer goods group, whose brands include Gillette razors, Ariel laundry detergent, Pampers diapers, Head & Shoulders shampoo, and Oral-B toothpaste, during a conference call... - Industry buzz
